high_level_description: stc brand style, a minimalist digital illustration of a pink dotted cityscape.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A light gray background gradually transitioning to white, giving the scene a soft, ethereal quality.

elements.desc: A skyline of high-rise buildings rendered in a pink dotted, pixelated style, connected by thin pink network lines, fading from darker pink in the foreground to lighter pink in the background, with a tall modern skyscraper on the right.
